sense: a way of doing something, especially of speaking or writing

terms.comment: genus dīcendī, a style of speaking.

terms.gloss: the pen; a manner of writing
terms.comment: Properly the writing stylus, then writing practice and the manner of writing.

phrases.latin: Antōnī genus dīcendī multō aptius jūdiciīs quam contiōnibus
phrases.english: Antonius’ style of speaking was much better suited to the courts than to public meetings
and he had brought a style of speaking that was far from common

sources: Lewis & Short: genus · Lewis & Short: stilus
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. style (architectural).
